name: Ersveil (open world)
author: Story Suite examples
description: The world of Ersveil as an open world for Story Block and Story Director, no RPG Battle needed: the calendar, the weather, a map of 320 towns, districts, dungeons and sites joined by 350 routes, world events, and data modules for standing with the powers, fame by region and Guild membership. It lists no items, shops, prices or foes: the story makes them up from the lore as it goes. A new story begins at the Adventurer Guild office in Bluewatch Village.

places.name: Highmark Capital
places.note: Imperial throne city of walled districts; seals, legal services and arms contracts.

places.name: Highmark Capital / Crown Keep
places.note: Palace, Diet and War Office; imperial warrants and sealed petitions.

places.name: Highmark Capital / Noble Heights
places.note: Walled noble estates: tailors, fine tack, household retainers.

places.name: Highmark Capital / Knight Quarter
places.note: Barracks and tilting yards; arms repair, cavalry tack, officer lodging.

places.name: Highmark Capital / Civic Ward
places.note: Tax courts, guildhalls and tenements; daily provisions and common lodging.

places.name: Iron Guard Fortress
places.note: Main imperial stronghold; armour repair and siege stores.

places.name: Barak Freeport
places.note: Highmark's southern port at the head of the Barak Gulf; Belis River freight lands here.

places.name: Oathmere
places.note: Highmark lake town of horse breeders and fishers (the lake of the same name lies beside it).

places.name: Stoneford
places.note: Fortified road town on the way to Barak; wagon repair, base for the Southmarch Road.

places.name: Ravenholt
places.note: Western border fortress at the head of the Barrens caravan road; raider watch.

places.name: Thousand Sails
places.note: River Council seat and fleet hub; bulk cargo and contract brokers.

places.name: Thousand Sails / Council Quay
places.note: River Council chambers and toll courts; charters and contract witnesses.

places.name: Thousand Sails / Grand Bazaar
places.note: Wholesale market and warehouses; bulk imports and foreign merchant courts.

places.name: Thousand Sails / Hulkrow
places.note: Old barges moored together as floating slums for the poor and those in hiding.

places.name: Ledgerford
places.note: Banking city: assay, deposits, bank notes, sealed contracts.

places.name: Ledgerford / Vault Row
places.note: The great banks behind armed vaults.

places.name: Ledgerford / Assay Hall
places.note: Every coin weighed, every note honoured or refused.

places.name: Ledgerford / Debtors' Steps
places.note: Public auctions of debts, collateral and bondfolk.

places.name: Bluewatch Village
places.note: Northernmost village: river watchpoint, Auvoth convoy supplies, cold-weather gear.

places.name: Bluewatch Village / Guild Office
places.note: Adventurer Guild branch desk where new arrivals register and read the job board.

places.name: Mirage City
places.note: Pleasure city of theatres, auctions and gambling credit.

places.name: Coinwater
places.note: Confederacy mint city; coin assay and sealed freight receipts.

places.name: Saltledger Quay
places.note: Estuary port: salt, fish, sea-river customs and pilot contracts.

places.name: Glassdock
places.note: Port for fragile cargo where the Bluewatch Branch meets the Glassdock Channel.

places.name: Lowmarket Reach
places.note: Caravan entry to Confederacy markets; freight transfer and Mirage-road guides.

places.name: Floodbell
places.note: Floodgate town: levee tools, emergency grain; second approach to Drowned Bell Vault.

places.name: Brightwater Lock
places.note: Fortified customs lock on the northern Ledger; gateway to Chainlock Depths.

places.name: Ferrywake
places.note: Ferry-chain town; start of the causeway to Drowned Bell Vault.

places.name: Marshledger
places.note: Estuary accounting town: salt and fish accounts, pilot contracts.

places.name: Shorn
places.note: Ducal capital and Confederacy bastion on the road to Auvoth.

places.name: Old Lantern Post
places.note: Shrine-town at the edge of settled land; lamp oil, trail blessings, wayfarer shelter.

places.name: Hearthmere
places.note: Hot-spring refuge town with bathhouses, winter lodging and reserve granaries.

places.name: Greyvein Camp
places.note: Mining camp and gateway to Rimeglass Delve; cold iron, blue coal, delve permits.

places.name: Frostgate
places.note: Last lock before Shorn and head of navigation; sledges beyond.

places.name: Rimebridge
places.note: Toll fortress tying Shornmarch to Ledgerford; convoy papers, guarded warehousing.

places.name: Wolfmere Outpost
places.note: Scout post on the Auvoth bastion road; reports, remounts, escort hire.

places.name: Hollin's Reach
places.note: Northernmost Shornmarch village; wool, mutton and hay by barter, little coin.

places.name: Auvoth
places.note: Neutral megadungeon city and Guild surface capital; charts, delver gear, salvage, dear food and beds.

places.name: Auvoth / Seventh Seal Terrace
places.note: Courts and sealed descents; arbitration, permits and seal services.

places.name: Auvoth / Delver's Crown
places.note: Guild Grand Hall ward: dungeon contracts, charts, delver lodging.

places.name: Auvoth / Outer Lamps
places.note: Southern gate ward: entry, convoy inspection, last-minute supplies.

places.name: Auvoth / Pale Market
places.note: Restricted salvage market: sealed auctions, forbidden salvage.

places.name: Auvoth / Boneglass Yard
places.note: Monster-material workshops: bone craft, iceglass, custom delver gear.

places.name: Auvoth / Ashbell Hospice
places.note: Hospital ward: wound care, amputation, frostbite and antidotes.

places.name: Holy City of Aurelion
places.note: Sacred capital around the First Brazier; relic craft, funerary goods, Church legal services.

places.name: Holy City of Aurelion / First Brazier
places.note: The sacred flame that never went out; authorised offerings and ritual appointments.

places.name: Holy City of Aurelion / Cathedral of the Eternal Flame
places.note: High cathedral and public doctrinal court; clerical records and petitions.

places.name: Holy City of Aurelion / Ashen Steps
places.note: Funeral stairs where the dead are carried up; urns, mourning cloth, procession services.

places.name: Holy City of Aurelion / Sepulcher of Saints
places.note: Saint tombs and sealed crypts under grave-warden watch.

places.name: Holy City of Aurelion / Great Reliquary
places.note: Fortified custody of relics; authentication and armed transfers.

places.name: Holy City of Aurelion / College of Flame Theologians
places.note: Clerical school and archive; manuscripts and doctrine instruction.

places.name: Holy City of Aurelion / Silent Cloisters
places.note: Monastic copying rooms and herb gardens; closed retreats under Inquest watch.

places.name: Holy City of Aurelion / Pilgrim Courts
places.note: Pilgrim lodging, communal meals and hearings.

places.name: Gravewarden Hold
places.note: Fortified abbey-town containing undead; grave seals and burial-patrol contracts.

places.name: Mercywell
places.note: Hospital town of monastic healers and plague quarantine; gateway to Ember Reliquary.

places.name: Saint Orven's Ford
places.note: Pilgrim ford on the Marrow; guides and ferry; gateway to the Drowned Cloister.

places.name: Davenford
places.note: Ulf River bridge town with noble customs; gateway to Briarhorn Labyrinth.

places.name: Mosskar
places.note: Gate-town at the south end of the Thornroad; mules and pass guides.

places.name: Coldwick
places.note: Frontier town of furs, trackers and warning bells; gateway to Wolfcairn Deeps.

places.name: Elderwall
places.note: Town on old imperial ruins; reclaimed stone, salvage licences, mountain road to Kraghollow.

places.name: Northcairn
places.note: Cairn-town for frontier war dead; memorial stone, winter stores.

places.name: Isbro
places.note: Ulf bridge and winter toll town; the river freezes hard.

places.name: Kvildal
places.note: Pilgrim and healing town: salves, rest-houses, snow-road guides.

places.name: Ironanvil Citadel
places.note: Principal dwarven forge-city and seat of the Council Beneath Stone; masterwork arms.

places.name: Ironanvil Citadel / Molten Core Great Forge
places.note: Never-cold central forge and dwarven mint; clan commissions and masterwork repair.

places.name: Ironanvil Citadel / Hall of Names
places.note: Ancestor stones of every clan; the Citadel's own hall.

places.name: Deepmantle Hold
places.note: Clanhold city of mithril veins; gateway to Deepmantle Hollow.

places.name: Thundershaft
places.note: Summit fortress below Thunderpeak; climbing gear and cold stores.

places.name: Windcutter Pass
places.note: High pass on the Ironanvil Mountain Road between Gateward Fortress and Gavrund; closes for weeks in deep winter, months in a hard winter.

places.name: Battle Cry City
places.note: Chieftain Council and Grand Muster city; warband contracts, plains mounts.

places.name: Battle Cry City / Muster Ground
places.note: Where the clans gather for war.

places.name: Battle Cry City / Fire Circle
places.note: Where the Chieftain Council speaks law.

places.name: Ancestral Spirit Mesa
places.note: Sacred mesa-town of clan rites and oath gatherings.

places.name: Fangmarket
places.note: Market of hides, leather and monster trophies; saltpeter is for tanning, preservation, dyeing and alchemy only (no gunpowder).

places.name: Talon Perch
places.note: Cliff town of griffin scouts; gateway to Skyclaw Eyrie.

places.name: Hurrakai
places.note: Fortified southern clan town on the Barak Gulf shore; start of the Coastway.

places.name: Abysswatch
places.note: Covenant council seat and naval command on a sea-fort rock; gateway to Leviathan Ribmaze.

places.name: Abysswatch / Fleet Basin
places.note: Warship docks and ropewalks.

places.name: Abysswatch / Admiralty Rock
places.note: Tidal Council and fleet command.

places.name: Vortex Port
places.note: Pirate refuge and smugglers' harbour.

places.name: Breakwater Hold
places.note: Fortified anti-pirate port; the Abyssal Gate route ends here.

places.name: Lanternshoal
places.note: Mainland lighthouse town: reef pilots, fog bells, emergency ship stores.

places.name: Blackvolc Isle
places.note: Volcanic isle of sulfur, obsidian and fire crystals; gateway to Blackglass Caldera.

places.name: Blackmast
places.note: Privateer port: prize cargo and illicit sea contracts.

places.name: Old Anchor Fort
places.note: Sea fortress; start of the Ghost Fleet Passage.

places.name: Atlantis
places.note: Deep-sea capital under a magical dome; coral craft and pressure-safe gear.

places.name: Atlantis / Tidevoice Plaza
places.note: Central ritual square; offerings and public proclamations.

places.name: Atlantis / Coralya's Crown
places.note: Royal district on the procession route; royal commissions.

places.name: Atlantis / Shellward Ring
places.note: Defensive ward-ring inside the dome; warded diving armour and patrol supplies.

places.name: Atlantis / Luminous Coral Ward
places.note: Craft ward of Sea-Light fragments, coral artisans and dome lamps.

places.name: Atlantis / Pearlquiet
places.note: Noble ward of elder families; fine pearls and private arbitration.

places.name: Atlantis / Abyssal Gate
places.note: Dome-gate for trench patrols; deep-sea permits, pressure gear, trench charts.

places.name: Atlantis / Singing Sand Bank
places.note: Ritual district for sacred sand and tide-chants.

places.name: Moonwhisper Ruins
places.note: Sacred ruin-city on Mirror Lake; digging permits and moonstone craft.

places.name: Starwater Quay
places.note: Mirror Lake port: moonstone, lake boats; elven end of the Rainbow Bridge.

places.name: Aurelith
places.note: Hollow-town of mana-lens artisans and message stones; gateway to Rootbound Observatory.

places.name: Greenveil Gate
places.note: Controlled gate into the elven lands; entry permits and approved guides.

places.name: Anwyth Sanctuary
places.note: Sacred grove of ancient trees and treaty stones.

places.name: Tearlight Waterfall
places.note: Sacred healing and purification waterfall.

places.name: Startrace Tower
places.note: Independent academy-city: books, instruments, research services, tutors.

places.name: Startrace Tower / Tower of Origin
places.note: Central archive, observatory and ritual hall; appointments only, no retail.

places.name: Startrace Tower / Ring of Foundation
places.note: Inner ring of dormitories, smithies, markets and storage courts.

places.name: Startrace Tower / Ring of Knowledge
places.note: Academy ring: lecture halls, libraries, laboratories.

places.name: Startrace Tower / Ring of Trials
places.note: Training ring of warded chambers, mock ruins and duelling grounds.

places.name: Startrace Tower / Oasis Gate
places.note: Caravan gate: water inspection, desert guides, entry permits.

places.name: Startrace Tower / Scholar's Rest
places.note: Inns, scribes, tutors and translators.

places.name: Startrace Tower / Glasswell
places.note: Mana-glass lenses, gauges and precision instruments.

places.name: Startrace Tower / Parchment Row
places.note: Copyists, binders and sealed scrolls.

places.name: Shackles City
places.note: Criminal-mercantile free city, a warren about 10 km across: smuggled cargo, false papers, mercenaries, debt brokers.

places.name: Dustbell
places.note: Western Barrens gate settlement affiliated with Shackles City: caravan checkpoint and mercenary hiring.

places.name: Westchain Hold
places.note: Fortified militia settlement guarding the Shackles-facing Barrens approach; gateway to Chain-Eater Pit.

places.name: Shackles City / Veil Market
places.note: Hidden market under the inner wards: stolen relics, forbidden maps, discreet appraisal.

places.name: Shackles City / Rust-Corroded Pipes
places.note: Tunnels under the old aqueducts; thieves' guild ground and smuggler passage.

places.name: Shackles City / Mute Sparrow Ward
places.note: Tavern ward and front for underground dealings; rumours and cheap beds.

places.name: Shackles City / Chainmarket
places.note: Slave and bond auctions beside contraband and stolen cargo.

places.name: Shackles City / Red Lock Quay
places.note: Riverward night smuggling quay; forged manifests.

places.name: Shackles City / Knifeglass Alley
places.note: Pit schools and pit fights, mercenary hiring; brokers and forgers in the back lanes.

places.name: Shackles City / Broken Coin Yard
places.note: Debt district of pawn courts and bonded-labour brokers (a name, not a coin).

places.name: Bloodbound Camp-City
places.note: Central mercenary contract camp; escrow, credit, sealed contracts.

places.name: Widow's Coin
places.note: Market town of death-pay claims and armour resale; a place name, not a coin.

places.name: Veilgrave
places.note: Hidden cult town under a ruined abbey; forbidden texts and hidden passages.

places.name: Black Prayer Hollow
places.note: Cursed town of heretical rites and grave pits.

places.name: Gallowsmere
places.note: Marsh town of corpse-lights and undead smuggling.

places.name: Ashpit Cloister
places.note: Ruined cloister-town trading forbidden texts and illicit cargo.

places.name: Lazar's End
places.note: Abandoned plague town now cult-held; gateway to Mournroot Catacomb.

places.name: Quiet Yard
places.note: Grave-town with a hidden ossuary market.

places.name: Wellscar
places.note: Well town controlling rare reliable water.

places.name: Dusthaven
places.note: Caravan town for Barrens crossings; water allotments and guides.

places.name: Redglass
places.note: Mining town of red sand glass; gateway to Redglass Labyrinth.

places.name: Cairnwatch
places.note: Watch town near the battlefield routes; ghost wards, scavenger permits.

places.name: Mirage Rest
places.note: Road-town tied to Mirage Spring rumours; not the true oasis.

places.name: Mirage Spring Oasis
places.note: Demiplane oasis that cannot be sought; this point is only an approximate manifestation anchor.

places.name: Wailford
places.note: Battlefield-edge town of ghost wards and relic scavengers; gateway to the Wailing Crown Vault.

places.name: Black Cistern
places.note: Fortified water town over an underground reservoir.

places.name: Stirrup Crossing
places.note: Crossing town and escort station; gateway to Pilgrim's Descent.

places.name: Echohammer
places.note: Mining town of cave-rescue crews; gateway to Echo Sink.

places.name: Witchwood Forest Center
places.note: Neutral magical forest about 100 km across under perpetual mist; navigation needs a Moonlight Compass.

places.name: Thunderpeak Summit
places.note: Storm peak above Thundershaft; no road, only climbing routes.

places.name: Winged Beasts Firmament
places.note: Floating-island Wildzone and flyers' roost; reached by air only.

places.name: Wailing Battlefield Edge
places.note: Cursed battlefield edge; ghost soldiers walk on moonless nights.

places.name: Silent Giant Necropolis
places.note: Behemoth remains with life crystals gatherable at the outer ribs.

places.name: Sea of the Ghost Fleet
places.note: Cursed sea where the ghost armada rises on moonless nights and storms; shares a coordinate with Nameless Isle on purpose.

places.name: Nameless Isle
places.note: Fog-wrapped isle at the heart of the Ghost Fleet sea; shares the sea's coordinate on purpose.

places.name: Island of Lost Time
places.note: Restricted ruin island of time-disorientation.

places.name: Abyssal Throat
places.note: Black-rock atoll around a sealed colossal pit; special sea region near Atlantis routes.

places.name: Glass Howl Icefield
places.note: Icefield of the apex direwolf Vaulkir; gateway to Sunless Crevasse.

places.name: Sunless Crevasse
places.note: Subglacial fissures with lich-type undead; forbidden expedition dungeon. Clearance SS-SSS; creature type alone sets no Soul Class or EG.

places.name: Crownless Glacier
places.note: Glacier of dragon signs, storm auroras and vanishing patrols.

places.name: Iron-Blue Tundra
places.note: Frozen apex tundra with giant elk, snow ogres and crystal-insect colonies.

places.name: Hollow Aurora Zone
places.note: Deep Wildzone under the circling light of the Pale Orbit.

places.name: Osterhal
places.note: Ardelian capital of nine peoples' quarters; imperial charters and election-season trade.

places.name: Osterhal / Ninefold Hall
places.note: Where the electors meet and emperors are chosen.

places.name: Osterhal / Citizens' Market
places.note: Food and craft of nine peoples.

places.name: Osterhal / Captive Yards
places.note: Sale yards for war captives, outside the walls.

places.name: Nareth
places.note: Dead city where no sound carries; Ardelian patrols turn travellers back.

places.name: Sorrowfen
places.note: Great marsh east of Ardelia.

places.name: Thornheart
places.note: Deep forest between Ardelia and Verdantleaf.

places.name: Vargate
places.note: Underworld harbour city of ward lords, slave factors and information brokers.

places.name: Vargate / Drowned Steps
places.note: Half-flooded lower harbour of smugglers and fences.

places.name: Vargate / Factor's Row
places.note: Slave factors' houses and holding pens.

places.name: Vargate / Silk Wards
places.note: Pleasure wards run by ward compacts, each on its own terms.

places.name: Vargate / Tolerated Ward
places.note: The Ashen Veil's tolerated temple and its buyers.

places.name: Glassmouth
places.note: Last waystation at the Barrens edge; Glass Road caravan staging.

places.name: The Glass Pits
places.note: Ashkaran slave pits on the wastes' western edge; no open market.

places.name: Ashkar
places.note: Ashkaran capital of mirrored glass, seat of the Glass Regent.

places.name: Ashkar / Regent's Mirror
places.note: The Glass Regent's palace of fused glass.

places.name: Ashkar / Bright Market
places.note: Glass-steel, slaves and western luxuries under sun-veils.

places.name: Ashkar / Pit Road
places.note: Start of the road east to the Glass Pits; Pit Road is also the corridor name.

places.name: Auvoth Depths
places.note: Largest known leyline megadungeon under Auvoth; recorded parties only. Clearance F-SSS (band 1 F-E, band 2 D); permits 2-4 silver a day for band 1, 6-12 for band 2; the Guild takes a tenth of salvage.

places.name: Rimeglass Delve
places.note: Seasonal licensed delve of moving ice galleries; Shornmarch licence 2-4 silver a day. Clearance C-B.

places.name: Briarhorn Labyrinth
places.note: Ducal-licensed thicket maze of regrowing passages and briar beasts. Clearance E-D.

places.name: Wolfcairn Deeps
places.note: Restricted border dungeon of pack predators, false trails and old war wards. Clearance C-B.

places.name: Crownscar Catacombs
places.note: Licensed imperial catacombs of animated guardians and unstable lower vaults. Clearance E-D.

places.name: Drowned Bell Vault
places.note: Chartered flooded dungeon of flash floods and undertow; water stones and old bronze. Clearance E-D.

places.name: Chainlock Depths
places.note: Lockmaster-chartered dungeon of pressure chambers and hostile constructs. Clearance D-C.

places.name: Ember Reliquary
places.note: Church-sealed reliquary vaults of sanctified traps; limited access under escort. Clearance D-C.

places.name: Saint Orven's Drowned Cloister
places.note: Church-licensed flooded ruin of collapsing crypts and drowned undead; old gold votives need assay before valuing. Clearance E-D.

places.name: Deepmantle Hollow
places.note: Clan-sealed high dungeon of living stone and sealed golems. Clearance B-A.

places.name: Echo Sink
places.note: Mapped guild dungeon of sound loops, shaft collapses and blind predators. Clearance D-C.

places.name: Pilgrim's Descent
places.note: Guarded holy-order dungeon of restless dead in narrow burial shafts. Clearance E-D.

places.name: Witchwood Rootwell
places.note: Witch-restricted living dungeon of rearranging roots and memory fog. Clearance B-A.

places.name: Fallen Meridian Vault
places.note: Academy-licensed research dungeon of spatial distortion and failed constructs. Clearance C-B.

places.name: Chain-Eater Pit
places.note: Illicit contested dungeon of unstable bindings and scavenger gangs. Clearance D-C.

places.name: Redglass Labyrinth
places.note: Caravan-chartered dungeon of mirage chambers, heat and burrowing predators. Clearance C-B.

places.name: Wailing Crown Vault
places.note: Forbidden battlefield dungeon; dense mana animates the dead ("high undead" is a taxonomy, not a Soul Class or EG). Clearance A-S.

places.name: Mournroot Catacomb
places.note: Cult-held catacomb of necromancers, intelligent undead and plague chambers. Clearance B-A.

places.name: Stormhoof Barrow
places.note: Clan-licensed ancestral barrow of territorial spirits and burrowing beasts. Clearance D-C.

places.name: Skyclaw Eyrie
places.note: Aerial-contract dungeon of wind shear and sheer drops, reached by cliff trail or griffin carry. Clearance C-B.

places.name: Leviathan Ribmaze
places.note: Tide-limited licensed sea dungeon of flooding passages and crushing tides. Clearance C-B.

places.name: Blackglass Caldera
places.note: Covenant-restricted volcanic dungeon of eruptions, toxic vents and fire monsters. Clearance B-A.

places.name: Drowned Archive
places.note: Atlantis-restricted deep dungeon of crushing depth and failing wards. Clearance A-S.

places.name: Rootbound Observatory
places.note: Enclave-sealed research dungeon of guardian roots and altered senses. Clearance C-B.

places.name: Mirrorroot Maze
places.note: Restricted ruin dungeon of reflection doubles and mana mirages, reached by boat. Clearance B-A.

places.name: Root-Tyrant's Range
places.note: Roaming range of the Root-Tyrant, centred on Thornheart; its presence is never guaranteed.

places.name: Mother of Reeds' Range
places.note: Roaming range of the Mother of Reeds, centred on Sorrowfen; marsh villagers leave offerings.

places.name: Black Trawl's Range
places.note: Roaming range of the Black Trawl at the margins of the Ghost Fleet sea.

places.name: Vaulkir's Range
places.note: Territory of the apex direwolf Vaulkir the Pale Maw on the Glass Howl Icefield.

places.name: Pale Orbit's Range
places.note: Sky above the Hollow Aurora Zone where the Pale Orbit circles; patrols that go out under it do not return.

events.cue: The branch clerk pins the day's F-letter notices: river-gate inspection, storehouse rats, brazier fuel for the signal keeper, a supply convoy to Auvoth. Registration is 1-2 silver; the Guild keeps a tenth to a fifth of every contract; salvage goes as the contract says; jobs above your letter are allowed at your own risk, and the Guild will not pay to recover a corpse.
